installCommand: mkdir -p /tmp/pnpm-bin && (command -v corepack || npm i --prefix /tmp/cp corepack) && PATH=$PATH:/tmp/cp/node_modules/.bin corepack enable pnpm --install-directory /tmp/pnpm-bin && PATH=/tmp/pnpm-bin:$PATH pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: mkdir -p /tmp/pnpm-bin && (command -v corepack || npm i --prefix /tmp/cp corepack) && PATH=$PATH:/tmp/cp/node_modules/.bin corepack enable pnpm --install-directory /tmp/pnpm-bin && PATH=/tmp/pnpm-bin:$PATH pnpm turbo run build --filter=mvp
